payment-use-case-catalog
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO public.payment_use_case_catalog (tenant_id, code, label, hint, sort_order, is_active, created_at, updated_at) SELECT NULL, seed.code, seed.label, seed.hint, seed.sort_order, true, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM (VALUES ('TICKET_SALE', 'Ticket sale', 'Event tickets and registrations', 1), ('DONATION', 'Donation', 'Standard donation checkout', 2), ('DONATION_CEFI', 'CeFi donation', 'CeFi charity donation checkout', 3), ('DONATION_ZERO_FEE', 'Zero-fee donation', 'Givebutter and other zero-fee donation checkout', 4), ('OFFERING', 'Offering', 'Church and parish offerings', 5), ('MEMBERSHIP_SUBSCRIPTION', 'Membership', 'Membership and subscription charges', 6), ('FEE_COLLECTION', 'Fee collection', 'School and campus fee invoices', 7) ) AS seed(code, label, hint, sort_order) WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.payment_use_case_catalog existing WHERE existing.code = seed.code AND existing.tenant_id IS NULL ); COMMENT ON COLUMN public.payment_provider_config.payment_use_case IS 'Code from payment_use_case_catalog. Null means this gateway serves every use case.';
